reading: ゆーえふおーきゃっちゃー
gloss: claw machine; UFO catcher; crane game

definitions.gloss: claw machine; UFO catcher; crane game
definitions.explanation: An arcade game machine in which players use a mechanical claw to try to grab prizes such as stuffed animals or candy. Originally a Sega brand name, now used generically in Japan for any such machine.

examples.japanese: UFOキャッチャー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ぬいぐるみ→ぬいぐるみ：05289_nuigurumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I grabbed a stuffed animal from the claw machine.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゲームセンター→ゲームセンター：27104_geemusentaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧UFOキャッチャー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}した→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧。
examples.english: I tried my luck at the claw machine at the arcade.

examples.japanese: UFOキャッチャー⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}た{目|め}→見た目：14110_mitame⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{難|むずか}しく→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧、⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{景品|けいひん}→景品：08319_keihin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れなかった→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
examples.english: The claw machine was harder than it looked, and I couldn't grab a prize no matter how many times I tried.

notes:
UFO catcher is a registered trademark of Sega, but is used as a common noun for all claw machines in Japan. The name refers to the UFO-shaped housing of early machines.
